neighbours.label: a split-off 'm' that begins a medical word ('non-m|edicinal', 'non-M|edicare', 'param|édical'), predicting 'edic'
fire: The bottle lists the medicinal and non-medicinal ingredients on the back.
Insurers tried to shift costs onto non-Medicare patients last year.
The clinic employs nurses, doctors and paramedical staff around the clock.
Each product label must name all non-medicinal ingredients and their source.
The study compared Medicare patients with non-Medicare patients in rural areas.
She trained in a paramedical field before going back to university.
Applicants must declare any non-medical reasons for the leave request.
Les professions médicales et paramédicales doivent suivre cette formation.
quiet: The bottle lists the active and non-active ingredients on the back.
Insurers tried to shift costs onto non-union workers last year.
The clinic employs nurses, cooks and maintenance staff around the clock.
Each product label must name all non-toxic ingredients and their source.
The study compared urban patients with non-urban patients in several areas.
She trained in a para-legal field before going back to university.
Applicants must declare any non-financial reasons for the leave request.
Les professions juridiques et commerciales doivent suivre cette formation.

notes: Card: top examples are '-m', '-M', ' param', Arabic ' للم' before مستشفى; output promotes 'edic' and suppresses whole ' med'/' medical' tokens. The - pole is the generic split ' m' (mule, masts, majeur), so the distinction is medical vs non-medical continuation. Near misses keep the hyphenated split-word form without medic-.
